Question: Can I claim an internet reimbursement while working from home?
Answer: Yes. Home internet is reimbursable up to Rs 1,500 per month against a bill in your own name. Submit it in Darwinbox under Expenses with the category "Internet". Claims for a shared or family-plan connection are accepted provided the bill shows your address.

Question: How do I add a newborn to my health insurance?
Answer: Raise the request in Darwinbox under Benefits within 30 days of the birth, attaching the birth certificate. Cover is effective from the date of birth once approved. Requests raised after 30 days are held until the next annual enrolment window in April.

Question: What is the relocation allowance?
Answer: Employees relocating at the company's request receive a one-time lump sum of Rs 75,000 for a domestic move, plus reimbursement of actual transport costs up to Rs 40,000 against invoices. Temporary accommodation is covered for up to 15 nights. The allowance is recoverable in full if you resign within 12 months of the move.

Question: Can I work from another city for a few weeks?
Answer: Short-term remote work from another Indian city is allowed for up to 30 days per year with manager approval. Beyond 30 days, or from outside India, you need HRBP plus function-head approval because of tax and payroll implications. Apply at least two weeks ahead in Darwinbox under Attendance.

Question: What happens to my ESOPs if I resign?
Answer: Vested options may be exercised within 90 days of your last working day, after which they lapse. Unvested options are forfeited on resignation. The exercise window is extended to 12 months in cases of retirement, permanent disability, or death. Contact esop@leadsquared.com for your current vesting statement.

Question: Is there a referral bonus for interns?
Answer: No. The referral programme covers full-time roles only. Intern referrals are welcome and are tracked, but they do not carry a payout. If an intern you referred converts to a full-time role, the standard junior-role referral bonus of Rs 25,000 applies from the conversion date.

Question: How do I get a salary certificate for a home loan?
Answer: Request it in Darwinbox under Letters, choosing "Salary Certificate". It is issued within two working days and emailed as a signed PDF. If your bank needs a specific format or additional details such as variable pay history, attach their template to the request.

Question: What is the policy on accepting gifts from vendors?
Answer: Gifts valued above Rs 2,500 must be declined or declared to compliance@leadsquared.com within five working days. Cash and cash equivalents such as gift cards must be declined regardless of value. Modest hospitality such as a working meal is acceptable and needs no declaration.
